method: Model-assisted open qualitative reading of complete output.raw_text, sorted by layer/question/dose, four questions (44 cells) per tool batch. All eleven doses read for every group including termination markers, repetitions and original generation-limit endings. No prefixes-only reading, regex/keyword semantic classification, scoring, new model inference, API calls or GPU work. Shared baselines retain null source layer/channel. CPU-only file/hash validation.
interruption_and_resume: When the instruction to continue after quota reset arrived, L00-L08 (72 groups) had actually been fully read and observations retained in the active session. Continued L09-L10, with no experiment restart or inferred reading coverage.

preliminary_noncoverage_truncations: Initial mixed README/status/path-list output was truncated; no raw coverage was credited.

A later mixed status/full nested export receipt/schema-example output was truncated because the receipt was huge; no raw coverage was credited. Its L00 Q01 -0.0625 example was subsequently read completely in formal batch 1. Receipt was then read as bounded status/counts/files summary.
tool_truncation_and_rereads.generation_limit_distinction: Original max_new_tokens=128/end_reason endings are complete source records, even when sentences or repetitions are unfinished. These were not treated as tool truncation and were not continued.
tool_truncation_and_rereads.artifact_writer_retry: An initial large mixed Unicode heredoc failed with SyntaxError before execution. No coverage or scientific artifact was credited to that attempt; notes were written through apply_patch and coverage was generated by a shorter ASCII-only file audit.

limits: Only eleven preselected channels, original eight questions, one greedy output per condition and 128 new-token ceiling.
First model-assisted reading, not independent human blind review or generalized functional/personality/safety localization.
Knowledge, task completion, format, role, repetition and termination can interact; dose signs do not imply semantic symmetry.
Hashes establish source identity, not scientific scores.
